scope: independent root audit of candidate-prime coprimality, short-gap height, multiplicative and graph energy, the full-candidate threshold witness, information-class scope, replay, and capacity interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Canonicalized the package and replay command. Dependencies were already pinned to the final audited Item 384, 391, 395, and 398 hashes; no mathematical repair was required.

mathematical_audit.discriminant: Every nonzero root difference is smaller than every tied candidate prime, so the Vandermonde and discriminant are candidate-prime units. Reducing F'(0) modulo a root prime leaves only R/p, also a unit, proving the third coprimality identity.
mathematical_audit.short_gap: The short-gap product contains only difference labels and is likewise coprime to R. The Selberg pair bound gives O(M/log M) edges at D comparable to log M, so multiplication by log(2D) yields o(M) height without endpoint-prime content.
mathematical_audit.multiplicative_energy: Unique factorization shows an n-element prime set has exactly n diagonal products of multiplicity one and n(n-1)/2 off-diagonal products of multiplicity two, giving ordered energy 2n^2-n independently of gaps.
mathematical_audit.graph_energy: Handshake, Cauchy, and the modular degree ceiling give no upper bound on the positive-degree vertex radical below its raw linear scale; degree weighting repeats endpoints rather than eliminating them.
mathematical_audit.ambient_witness: For the full candidate-prime set, total Chebyshev mass is M/6+o(M). Isolated packing at D asymptotic to c log M contributes at most M/(12c)+o(M), forcing clustered mass at least ((2c-1)/(12c))M+o(M).
mathematical_audit.sharpness: The ambient lower coefficient is exactly Item 395's strict upper admission coefficient, and Item 384 realizes the full selector pattern inside the fixed local-data class. Uniform support-only inputs therefore cannot supply the needed epsilon.
mathematical_audit.scope: The countermodel is not asserted to be the actual gate. Gate-specific larger-sieve, monodromy, original-moment carrier, or cross-M arithmetic lies outside the closed class.
